text: Cobalt Harbor performed an offline incident readiness review for annotation evidence log jsonl s006629 on 2026-07-15. The evidence question was: Which responsibility boundary must be visible before the record is approved? The response coordinator assembled the source facts; the case reviewer tested their ownership trace. The review relates AC-27 to evidence set 184 and records RISK-031 as the governing risk reference. Dependency context: no upstream dependency. The source record is p03-src-006629 and this artifact is p03-full-006629. The evidence instrument was the evidence custody note; the reviewer observed that the conclusion identified the next assurance trigger. During challenge, a duplicated statement was not accepted as independent corroboration. Review profile: the evidence set was collected during the follow-up review; the accountable owner confirmed the operating boundary; the reviewer sampled an adverse operating condition; the source fact supported acceptance without qualification; the comparison used the prior review conclusion; the evidence was retained with the decision record; the exception path was considered and recorded; the reviewer assessed a handover impact; the decision was suitable for targeted follow-up; the source chronology was complete; the control claim was independently corroborated; the review boundary identified unavailable material as a limitation; the next assurance trigger is completion of the follow-up action; the disposition was communicated to the owner; the retained rationale supports repeat review; the record remains a local offline assurance artifact. Counterexample considered: A complete-looking register is not reliable if the decision rule and disposition are absent. Decision rule: Record an approval only after the reviewer can reproduce the conclusion from the retained facts without network access. Disposition: accepted with a retained review note. No Kio capability is used or required for this offline review.
